name: Manas Lifestyle Resort Igatpuri
why_special: Mid-luxury wellness resort across 12 acres in the Sahyadri foothills — 76 rooms, full-service Ayurveda spa, indoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant. The Igatpuri destination wellness resort that pairs naturally with Dhamma Giri Vipassana meditation visitors.

name: The Fern Igatpuri
why_special: Fern Hotels' eco-certified Igatpuri resort with 56 rooms — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the polished mid-range brand pick. Closer to the Mumbai-Agra highway exit than Manas.
